tei:div.tei:p: ༈ /dpal gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgrogs ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// char sprin dbus na 'jigs pa'i skur ston cing*// glog 'phreng 'khyug pa'i spyan gsum rnam par g.yo// rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bstan pa skyong bar mdzad// gri gug thod pa thabs shes zung du sbrel// chu gter dbus na ri rab lhun po bzhin// gzi brjid phung po mthu stobs dpag tu med// nyin byed 'od kyis skar ma'i tshogs bzhin du// mi mthun bdud dpung tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon// zhabs kyi gom pa bskyod pas mtha' yas shing*// rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis bskyod pa ltar// sdig mdzub gdong nyid yongs su bstan pa'i tshe// lhun po'ang g.yo ba med par sdod dam snyam// zad pa'i dus kyi me lce 'bar ba yang*// zhal kyis dbugs cig btab pas rab tu zhi// drag po'i mche ba 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi// spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'debs par gzas pa bzhin// 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs rab tu sgrogs pa las// mthu stobs rlom pa'i gnod byed tshogs rnams kyang*// nye bar dmigs nas phyogs bcur byer ba dang*// gang la skyabs gsol de kun bsrung bar mdzad// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bskyod pa'i 'od// nyi ma bye ba'i 'od zer 'phrog par byed// sku yi dkyil 'khor drag por bskyod pa yis// ma lus 'jig rten khams kyang rab tu g.yo// 'gran pa'i zla med gur gyi mgon po la// bstod pa'i dge bas mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// rab tu zhi zhing thugs bstan rgyas pa dang*// sgrub pa po rnams yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod// ces dpal gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa rmad du byung ba'i sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan srung dam pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba// mi 'jigs mthu ldan pha rol zil gyis gnon// zhing khams kun tu dgyes pa'i gar bsgyur zhing*// 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum mtha' dag g.yo// dbus zhal rab 'jigs mche ba 'jigs pa ston// g.yas g.yon glang chen dang ni ma he'i zhal// rgyab zhal seṅge'i gdong pa spyan gsum dmar// kun tu gzigs pas gdon dang bgegs rnams 'joms// ma lus dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad phyir// rab mdzes mtshon cha du ma 'dzin pa dang*// rnal 'byor nyon mongs tshogs kun bsreg bya'i phyir// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// 'jigs byed chen po gdong bzhi ldan pa la// 'jigs rung yum chen drag mo bzhi yis bskor// 'jigs mdzad sprul pa'i pho nya du ma 'gyed// 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs rung 'khor dang bcas la 'dud// gang la bstod tshig cung zad bgyis pa 'dis// bstod pas mnyes pa'i dga' char 'bebs gyur cig

/ces dpal gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mgon po a gho ra la bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan skyong chen po gzi brjid phung po can// thun mtshams sprin gyis dmar ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing*// smin mtshams dbus su nyi zla'i gzi 'od 'bar// me dang dur khrod 'jigs rung dbus na bzhugs// phyag g.yas bdud rnams ma lus sdigs byed pa// tsandan beng chen sgeg pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin// g.yon pa zhi byed sman gyi gang bu bsnams// yid 'ong ber gyi na bza' sku la gsol// bka' sdod nag po dpal ldan lha mor bcas// 'khor tshogs phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la// rab gus dang ba'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi// yongs su bstod pa kun nas mnyes gyur cing*// rnal 'byor pa la dngos grub mchog stsol cig /ces mgon po a gho ra la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mgon po phyag drug pa la bstod pa dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can bstan pa srung mdzad pa// me lce rab tu 'bar bas bdud dpung bsregs// glog 'od 'khyug 'dra'i spyan gsum rab 'bar bas// phas rgol bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms par byed// baiḍūrya yi phung po brtsegs pa bzhin// gnod sbyin pho mo'i steng na 'gying bag can// 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa dang*// thod pa'i phreng ba do shal rgyan du byas// gzi brjid phung pos las kun sgrub byed pa// 'khor tshogs du ma'i dbus na mngon mtho zhing*// thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /myur mdzad nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// rmad byung dam can khyod la bstod pa yis// rnal 'byor can gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// dngos grub kun stsol thub bstan rgyas pa yis// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba 'phel bar shog

/ces phyag drug pa la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dkar mo nyi zla la bstod pa mi 'jigs pa'i gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// yid 'ong zla ba'i 'od ni 'phrog byed cing*// rab dkar gangs ri phung po brtsegs 'dra ba// phyag g.yas ri dbang lhun po 'dzin pa dang*// g.yon pas gling bzhi thur la bzlog pa bsnams// nyi ma'i 'od kyis rnam mang rgyu skar bzhin// mi mthun bdud kyi dpung rnams zil gyis gnon// sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas mdzes byas shing*// nyi zla stong gi phreng bas rgyan du byas// spyi bor nyi zla'i 'od zer stong 'bar bas// sprul pa dpag med 'gyed pa'i mthu dang ldan// rnal 'byor dam tshig can rnams skyong mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod// gang la bstod pa'i me tog phul ba yis// phyogs dus kun tu dge legs 'byung bar mdzod// ces bstan srung dkar mo nyi zla la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /pu tra lcam sring gsum la bstod pa snyan pa'i rnga chen zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs las legs 'khrungs shing*// phan bde las rnams bsgrub la brtson mdzad pa// myur mgyogs drag po'i las la rngam pa yis// rnam dag zhing du dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor can la nye ba'i thugs mnga' ba// dam pas bka' bsgos bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad// rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan 'byung po'i gnod pa 'joms// bar chad zhi ba'i las kun bsgrub byed pa'i// bka' srung lcam sring rnams la rab tu bstod// khyod la bstod tshig yid 'ong phul ba yis// rnam pa kun tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang*// thos bsam sgom pa kun tu 'phel bar mdzod// ces pu tra ming sring la bstod pa rong ston chen pos sbyar ba'o//

༈ /dpal bdud rgyal thod phreng la bstod pa mthu stobs bskyed byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// phas rgol zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu ldan zhing*// rab 'jigs thod pa'i phreng ba rgyan du byas// myur mgyogs rngam pa rta pa'i dpung tshogs can// rnal 'byor bar chad bzlog pa'i mthu bo che// dam pas bsngags pa'i lam la rab brtson zhing*// mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang stobs po che// rno ba'i mtshon thogs khro ba'i bzhin mdangs can// bstan srung drag po 'khor dang bcas la bstod// mtshan mo rgyu ba 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun// nye bar mi gnas ring du mthar byed la// rab tu bstod pa'i mthu las chos grwa 'di'i// mthun rkyen kun sgrub 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// ces bdud rgyal thod phreng can la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa la bstod pa rnam rgyal ba'i bstod dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan srung dam pa gzi brjid phung po can// phyogs su rab rgyas rnam bzhi'i phyag ldan pa// 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa can// ma lus dgra bgegs mthar byed khyod la 'dud// bsil ba'i tshal na klu sgrub snying po yis// gus pas spyan drangs rkang brgyad tshig gis bstod// bstan pa mi nyams yongs su bsrung mdzad pa// kun las rnam rgyal bdud kyi bdud la bstod// mtha' yas zhing skyong dbus na mngon par mtho// rnal 'byor can la dngos grub ster mdzad cing*// mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms pa'i mdzad pa can// bstan srung dam pa khyod la rab tu bstod// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyis// mi mthun phyogs kun rab tu zhi ba dang*// mthun pa'i rkyen rnams lhun gyis grub pa dang*// thub bstan rgyas pa'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod// ces ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i bstod dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
